model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the CoLeGe-E (ColegE-E) score for different LLaMA-2 models scaled with varying amounts of supervised fine-tuning (SFT) data. The horizontal axis displays the model names: LLaMA-2-7B, LLaMA-2-13B, and LLaMA-2-70B, ordered from left to right. The vertical axis represents the CoLeGe-E score as a percentage, ranging from approximately 5 to 48, utilizing a linear scale with tick intervals of 5%. The bars are grouped by the amount of SFT data applied, with four distinct color-coded sets of bars representing “no SFT,” “+ SFT on D0,” “+ SFT on D0, D1,” and “+ SFT on D0, D1, D2.”  The bar labeled “no SFT” for LLaMA-2-7B is approximately 28%, the bar for LLaMA-2-13B is approximately 32%, and the bar for LLaMA-2-70B is approximately 38%. The tallest bar, representing “+ SFT on D0, D1, D2” for LLaMA-2-70B, reaches a value of approximately 43%, while the shortest bar, representing “no SFT” for LLaMA-2-7B, reaches a value of approximately 13%. The bars are not sorted in any particular order, and none of the bars are visually emphasized beyond their distinct color coding.
